Q-Learning Agent Router
Intelligent task-to-agent routing using reinforcement learning

Usage: claude-flow route <task> [options]
       claude-flow route <subcommand>

Subcommands:
  - task         - Route a task to optimal agent
  - list-agents  - List available agent types
  - stats        - Show router statistics
  - feedback     - Provide routing feedback
  - reset        - Reset router state
  - export       - Export Q-table
  - import       - Import Q-table

How It Works:
  - Analyzes task description using hash-based state encoding
  - Uses Q-Learning to learn from routing outcomes
  - Epsilon-greedy exploration for continuous improvement
  - Provides confidence scores and alternatives

Backend Status:
  - RuVector: Available
  - Backend: ruvector-native

Run "claude-flow route <subcommand> --help" for more info
